checkpointPayload.title: Hero artifact 5-color breakpoints, capped resource ping highlight, and item assets in inventory

taskChanges.newValue: Applied 5-tier color scale to Hero artifacts (1-25 gray, 26-50 green, 51-70 blue, 71-85 violet, 86-100 orange) with gray instead of pure white for tier 1 and 1-star starIcons. Highlighted capped and maximum resources with hwa-mail-dot-ping animation on Energy, World Energy, and header resource pills. Extracted 101 item asset PNGs from CDN via generate-item-assets.mjs, and rendered borderless inventory grid with item icons and full in-game names in tooltips. Version bumped to v0.9.33.
